snippet.title: Tracing Official Trailer
snippet.description:
https://jungwooyom.itch.io/tracing

A Game by Jungwoo Yom.

Tracing is a cyberpunk-themed adventure game about saving human knowledge. The government is trying to incinerate invaluable materials in order to extended their period of power. You and your team have to save those materials and copy them to optical discs.

Infer the location of the materials through searching government database with keywords based on traces you have. Some deductive process is required to get crucial hints about the location. After that, find the location in the city. There are no map markers or dotted lines, so you'll have to wander around the city to find the location.
